text: Maxime is a Breton thief found just outside Bhosek's Palace in Port Hunding, in the region of Stros M'Kai.
Mayor Orrard is a Breton mayor of the town of Fell's Run, Rivenspire.
Meer-Mesei is an Argonian residing in the Crossroads Encampment, Craglorn.
Mathin Areloth is a Dunmer weaponsmith. He sells his wares at his stall, Areloth's Best Blades, in the Artisans Alley of Dune.
Mazduni-daro is a Khajiit merchant. She sells her wares at her caravan in Dune.

Mayor Aulus is an Imperial and the mayor of Southpoint. His mind has be corrupted by the Mad God Sheogorath, which led to a series of events resulting in Southpoint's resident becoming completely crazed.
Mazilbin is a Khajiit residing in the town of Alten Corimont.
Mazuk is a Khajiit found aboard The Blasted Breton in Alten Corimont.
Mazabakh is an Orsimer innkeeper found in The Greedy Gut in the city of Orsinium. The tavern is connected to Mazabakh's House by an underground tunnel.

Medar Othralas is a Dunmer found inside the Temple of Ire in Orsinium. He cannot be interacted with, but can be seen listening to the readings of the book of Trinimac by Ordatha, together with Aeedika and Alessiac Barthel.
Meema-Zaw is an Argonian found at the Two Notched Hilts in Arenthia.
Maylde is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact stationed in Fort Virak.
Mazar is a Khajiit skooma-peddler. He works at the mine of Cat's Eye Quay, which he also uses as place to stash his merchandise.
Maxim Falvo is an Imperial commoner residing in Abah's Landing.
Mathesa Darano is a Dunmer residing inside her house in Abah's Landing.
Mathilie Northwind is a Breton residing in the city of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Mederic Vyger is a Breton scholar and a former member of the Scaled Court. He seeks the Vestige's help in sealing away dangerous creatures inside Skyreach.
Mazha is a Khajiit entertainer found in the audience hall of the castle in Anvil. He can't be interacted with.

Maxivian Faleria was the son of Ianus Faleria and a merchant's daughter. He was the paternal grandson of Lord Nunex Faleria and Lady Faleria, though his maternal grandparents were horrified of his elvish features.
Mathiisen Soldier is are generic Altmer NPCs residing in Mathiisen, Auridon.

Mazgar gra Yagash was a female Orsimer, member of the Imperial Legion, and survivor of the sack of Orsinium during the Fourth Era. She was an Imperial scout before she was promoted to Captain by Commander Prossos, who gave her a field promotion.
Mathei is an Argonian patron of the Coin Brothers' Cornerclub in Stormhold.
Meejapa is an Argonian that was tasked with scouting out a Covenant camp that was established near Lukiul Uxith.
Meenai-Makka is an Argonian provisioner residing inside her hut in Lukiul Uxith.
Mathragor is a Bosmer residing in the Bloodtoil Valley. He is the father of Dalaneth.
Matron Brendil is a Bosmer and one of the spiritual guardians of Treehenge. She was once The Green Lady.
Matron Elanas is a Bosmer and one of the spiritual guardians of Treehenge. She was once The Green Lady.
Matron Irwiraen is a Bosmer and one of the spiritual guardians of Treehenge. She was once The Green Lady.
Matron Borbuga is an Orc character residing in Stonetooth Fortress. She is encountered during the "Stonetooth Bash" quest. She appears only during the New Life Festival.
Mathias Raiment is a Breton residing in Wind Keep. He is a close friend of Countess Ilise Manteau, acting as a sort of confidant in her time of grief.
Matilda is a Breton traveling merchant. She is found on the road near the Windy Glade Wayshrine.

Matthiaume was a Breton knight of Arkay. He was part of the small team that is currently searching Rivenspire for sacred relics. He was tasked with scouring the Flyleaf Catacombs for relics, but was murdered by the bandits established inside.
Matthieu Vette is a Breton member of the Saltwalker Militia. He is found at their camp in the Alik'r Desert.
Matys Derone is a dying Breton found inside the ruins of Norvulk in Stormhaven.
Maul Cerone is a Breton residing in Kerbol's Hollow. He can be found working in a forge.
Maurice Baelborne is a Breton spirit found in his former estate. He is the father of Athel, the current owner.
Maxine Stieve is a Breton noble found inside Velmont Mansion in Abah's Landing.
Mayla Hinault is a Breton in found hiding from rampaging bloodfiends with her family on their farm just outside Shornhelm, Rivenspire.
Mayor Gette was the Breton mayor of Crestshade. She was one of the many who perished when Reezal-Jul unleashed a horde of bloodfiends on the town.

Medya Zurric is a Reachmen residing in Murcien's Hamlet. Under the veil of being an innocent and friendly healer, she allied herself with the Dark Witnesses in order to bring about the destruction of the village.
Mastrius Drarara is a Dunmer scholar and member of House Hlaalu residing inside their kinhouse in Narsis, Deshaan.
Maulborn Commander Arvys is a Dunmer and high-ranking member of the Maulborn Cult. He leads their forces in the Obsidian Gorge.
Maulborn Commander Kalara is a Dunmer and a high-ranking member of the Maulborn Cult. She leads the forces found within the Mournhold Sewers.
Maulborn General Darvasen is a Dunmer and a high-ranking member of the Maulborn Cult. He leads the forces attempting an hostile takeover in Shad Astula.
Mavus Talnorith is a Dunmer and a member of the Mages Guild. He acts as the champion of the eighth round of the Dragonstar Arena.
Meden Berendus is a Dunmer guild trader. He is part of the gang of outlaws found inside the outlaws refuge underneath Windhelm.

Mebs Runnyeye is a goblin of the Bloody Hand Tribe. He is one of the three bosses encountered inside Cracked Wood Cave. Mebs has a chance to drop the unique battleaxe, Meb's Chopper of Cyrodiil's Crest.
Mazgak is an unused Orsimer that was supposed to make an appearance in the quest "Ill Met by Moonlight," but did not make it into the final version of the game.
Maxus the Many is a Golden Saint acting as the final boss of the Maelstrom Arena's first round.
Medallus is an Imperial encountered in The Foundry of Woe. He was part of Lyris Titanborn's squad during her time in the Imperial Legion.
Mazram is a Khajiit residing in the city of Vulkhel Guard, Auridon.
Mazurr is a Khajiit of the Baandari Clan. He is found in their camp at the Martyr's Crossing.
Mazirzin is a Khajiit laborer residing in Vulkhel Guard. He has no unique dialogue.

Meehn Half-Tail is a deceased female character in the New Sheoth Graveyard. She is one of eight other inhabitants of the Shivering Isles already buried at the arrival of the Hero of Kvatch on the isles.
Medyn Hleran is a Dunmer caravaner residing in the Caravaner Tower in Seyda Neen, Vvardenfell. He offers travel to Gnisis and Suran.
Mathon is a Nord found inside his house in Mud Tree Village.

Mathondar Blackrock is a Nord that has taken shelter within Elinhir Sewerworks along with the other residents of Elinhir, away from the renegade Blackcaster Mages Guild. He is guarding the door alongside Lyna Ergene.
Medveig is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact that has been tasked with tracking down Yngrel the Bloody, a wanted criminal in The Rift.
Maulborn Enforcer is a generic Enforcer residing in several locations in .

Menoosh is an Argonian warrior residing in Bramblebreach in the region of Greenshade, Valenwood. He is usually wandering around Ciireriath's Home and the Treethane's Chambers in the western part of the small town.
Mazogug the Bold is an Orsimer member of the Malacath Fanatics, who have stormed the Temple of Ire in the city of Orsinium.
Meder Nerethi is a Dunmer member of the Clockwork Apostles residing in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.
Mavon Mavani is a Dunmer residing in the ruin of Ashalmimilkala in Vvardenfell. He has no unique dialogue.
Meeh-Chuna is an Argonian commoner found dancing to Orninlusea's performance in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. She has no unique dialogue.
Maya Doran is a Breton who can be found in the Illumination Academy in Summerset.
Mazgroth is an Orsimer hunt-wife of Chief Gloorot and the daughter of Lurg, residing in Exile's Barrow.
Mazza-Mirri is an ancient Alfiq spirit and clan mother of the Order of the Hidden Moon residing at the Ashen Scar in Northern Elsweyr.
Meeh-Zish is an Argonian Battlegrounds Furnisher residing in the Gladiator's Quarters outside of Solitude.
Maugh is an Orsimer residing in The Lonely Troll in Solitude.

Matron Urgala is a Bretion member of the Icereach Coven found in Deepwood Barrow. She is the leader of one of the coven's branches, as well as the one that locked the Vestige and Fennorian in the barrow.
Mathys is a Breton beggar who can be encountered at various locations across Grahtwood. Helping him counts toward the "Give to the Poor" achievement.
Meer-Ta, the Zephyr Eternal is an Argonian found near Stonewastes in .
Mazra is a Redguard located in Morwha's Bounty, Alik'r Desert, in . He is a member of the Ash'abah.
Maurice Ouren is a Breton residing in the Slag Town Outlaws Refuge.

King Maxevian was a King of Daggerfall during the Second Era. He is known for issuing military orders to the Pale Watch following the destruction of Orsinium and the subjugation of the Orcs in Wrothgar.
Matilda Lemonds is a Breton chef residing within the Alcaire Castle, in Stormhaven. She works at the Old Goat Inn, where her mother, Marthe, is the innkeeper.

Mephala (Daedric script: ) is the Daedric Prince of obfuscation and secrecy. She is known by the names Webspinner, Spinner, Spider, Androgyne, and Plot-Weaver, and her sphere is sometimes claimed to be lies, sex, murder, and secrets, but others claim her true sphere is obscure to mortals. She is worshiped by the Dunmer as one of the "Three Good Daedra" in their pantheon. She enjoys seducing and interfering in mortal affairs, presumably for her own amusement, though others suspect her manipulations are for a greater purpose. Mephala is the ruler of the Spiral Skein and more obfuscated domains in Oblivion tied together by magical ghostweb. Mephala's minions are known as Spider Daedra. The Mora

Merandil is an Altmer guard. He is one of the Kvatch soldiers the Hero of Kvatch encounters holding the barricade when they visit Kvatch. He takes part in the battle that ensues after closing the Kvatch Oblivion Gate.
Menelin is a Bosmer Commoner found in Molag Mar at St. Veloth's Hostel atop the city. She is unarmed and wears common clothing. She does not offer any services and is not involved in any quests.
Menus Felas is a Dunmer farmer who resides in his farmhouse in Vos, Morrowind.
Mehra Drora is a Dunmer Priestess living in Gnisis in the West Gash. She is also a member of House Indoril.

Melisi Daren is the taxidermist that can be hired by purchasing the Battlehorn Trophy Hall upgrade from Nilphas Omellian. She resides in her office in the East Wing of Battlehorn Castle, and can make stuffed creatures that will be placed on the pedestals in the great hall for display when she is provided with the appropriate material for the creature. She can produce one stuffed creature per day.

Melus Petilius is an Imperial living in a small cottage just outside the settlement of Brindle Home. Melus used to be a local hero, slaying beasts and helping the villagers out. But while he was out fighting, his wife, Vena Petilius, died of a fever. As such, he has sworn to never carry a weapon again. He blames himself for her dying and his not being there for her. He visits her grave every day around 11 am.

Mensa Selas is a Dunmer and a bandit archer. She is a member of Mogens Wind-Shifter's Bandits. She is camped northeast of Leyawiin near Fisherman's Rock, with her fellow gang members Mogens Wind-Shifter, J'Baasha, and Ayisha.

Menien Goneld is a Kvatch Guard who was captured by the Daedra when Savlian Matius sent a contingent of guards into the Breaking the Siege of Kvatch. After entering the gate, the guards were ambushed and Menien was captured. He is taken to one of the towers and placed in a cage.

Mercer Frey is the Breton leader of the Thieves Guild located in Riften and the primary antagonist of the Thieves Guild questline in The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim. He is also the owner of Riftweald Manor in Riften, although he is never actually found in or around this location.
Melaran is an Altmer who serves as the housecarl to Erikur. He can be found either inside Erikur's House or in the Blue Palace.
Melka is a friendly hagraven in Blind Cliff Bastion in Blind Cliff Cave.
Mendel Eves is a deceased Nord Buoyant Armiger who met his demise in the Bladder of Clovis.

Mena is a Breton citizen residing at Enmon's House in the town of Karthwasten. She is the wife of Enmon and the mother of Fjotra. She is typically found within her house during twenty-four hours a day.
Menro was a Atmoran warrior and craftsman who lived during the Merethic Era. He was one of the Five Hundred Companions.
Melvona Marvayn is a Dunmer Enforcer and House Cousin of House Hlaalu residing in Omani Manor on Elmas Island. She carries a key to the manor.

Mehra Milo is a Dunmer priest of the Tribunal Temple, an intercessor between Almsivi and their worshippers, caretaker of the temple and shrines, and councilor and educator for the faithful and laymen. Initially, she can be found in the library of the Temple.
Melsu Indalas is a Dunmer Rogue and slaver residing in the stronghold of Hlormaren. She is located in the top level of the stronghold's keep.
Menta Na is a Daedroth who served Molag Bal before retreating to his dungeon, Kora-Dur.
Meralyn Othan is a Dunmer commoner who can be found wandering in the Great Bazaar in Mournhold.
Melvure Rindu is a Dunmer Witchhunter and is also a member of the Tribunal Temple, who resides in Vivec City, in the Hall of Justice.

Mehra Nabisi was a Dunmer Triune of the New Temple of Morrowind sometime in the Third or Second Era. She is mentioned in the book Where Were You When the Dragon Broke? speaking of the deception of the ALMSIVI, when they were considered saviors of the Dunmer.
Meluria Seleth is a Dunmer commoner who resides in her home in Sadrith Mora.
Meleril is an Altmer who resides within Port Hunding. She can be seen having numerous conversations with Abdahel.
Melie Frenck is a Breton Temple novice. She is serving in the Telvanni Temple, in the Vivec, Telvanni Canton. She sells potions and has four spells available to sell.

Mekag gro-Bug is an Orsimer residing in Saintsport, Stros M'Kai. He is one of Crafty Lerisas crew and has been captured by the Sea Drakes. He has a crush on Lambur, but so far she has not shown any interest in him.

Merail Avani is a Dunmer blacksmith residing in the city of Davon's Watch, Stonefalls. He works and sells his wares at his stall, Avani Bladeworks, in the Artisans' Row. He is a widower, as his wife died in the Second Akaviri Invasion of 2E 572. He has two children, Arvys and Durena Avani.
Melvuli Hlaalu is a Dunmer commoner who resides in the Vivec, St. Olms Canton. Her address is St. Olms Waist South-One and can be reached directly from outside the first level of the St. Olms Canton.
Melina Edier is a Breton held hostage with her husband by the Red Rook Bandits in a house outside Daggerfall.
Melluin is a Bosmer residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.
Melledh is a Bosmer enchanter residing in Woodhearth in the region of Greenshade.
Mendros is a Bosmer residing in Woodhearth in the region of Greenshade.
Melynie Gousse is a Breton patron of the Outside Inn in Elden Root.
Menelras is a Bosmer Slave who resides in Tel Aruhn. He can be purchased for 1,000 and will aid the Nerevarine in battle.
Mendyn Indrano is a Dunmer merchant. He sells his wares at his stall, Indrano's Wonderful Wares, in Ebonheart.
Mehra Uvandrys is a Dunmer priest found inside their temple in Davon's Watch.

Menlin, otherwise known as Acolyte Menlin, is a character who resides in Azra's Crossing and can be found in the temple. She is distraught because the herbs the temple held had been stolen by bandits, and she was in charge of maintaining them. She asks the Hero to retrieve them for her, as part of the main quest.
Melur Savil is a Dunmer rogue. He is a member of a gang found in Old Mournhold's Residential Sewers beneath Godsreach in Mournhold.
Melius Kane was a publisher in the Imperial City who published Destri Melarg's books and to whom Destri addressed his letter, Notes for Redguard History.
Merani-Dra is a Khajiit commoner found at the Temple of Two-Moons Dance in Khenarthi's Roost.
Meldil is an Altmer found in the Ezduiin Undercroft in Auridon, and is a member of the Mages Guild.
Mendreval is a Bosmer leatherworker residing in the city of Marbruk.
Mengilwaen is an Altmer guild trader. She sells her wares at the City's Edge Stalls in Belkarth.
Mehrzad is a Redguard stablemaster residing in the city of Hallin's Stand, and runs Sandy Pasture Stables.
Merarii Varyon is a Dunmer found inside the instruction halls of Shad Astula.
Melil Beleth is a Dunmer chef. He sells his wares at his stall, Melil Beleth's Swamp Food, in Hissmir.
Meldagar is a Nord laborer residing in Windhelm and located in its docks.
Meling Snow-Bourne is a Nord weaponsmith. She sells her wares at her stall, Ice & Fire Weaponry, at Oaken-Hull's Emporium in Windhelm.
Meleras is a Bosmer residing in the city of Elden Root. He is the caretaker of The Orrery of Elden Root.

Melila Daveleth is a Dunmer residing in Davon's Watch. She can be found begging on the street alongside her husband, Loryvn. They lost their home and baby daughter in the midst of the Daggerfall Covenant bombardment of the city and are now homeless and penniless.
Meranya is an Altmer member of the Mages Guild residing in the city of Riften.
Melbethil is a Bosmer woodworker residing in the city of Haven. She sells her wares at her stall, Adventurer's Implements.
Menthorn is a Bosmer merchant residing in the city of Haven.
Merani is a Khajiit member of the Fighters Guild. She is found at their branch in Arenthia.
Mercenary Marauder is a character residing in the city of Stormhold.
Mercenary Recruit is a character residing in the city of Stormhold.
Menninia is a Bosmer found in the Clan Longhouse in Morkul Stronghold, Wrothgar.
Meram Farr is a Dunmer bounty hunter found near the entrance to the Thukhozod's Sanctum in Wrothgar. She is married to her business partner Bardun.
Mendarie is an Altmer farmer residing in Phaer. She is one of the many who fell victim to the plague afflicting the town, and so cannot be spoken with.
Mendol is an Altmer spirit found lingering on a cliff overlooking the sea at the Soulfire Plateau. In life, he was one of Ancalin's children.
Melas is a Bosmer mystic and member of the Mages Guild residing in Velyn Harbor. He is found at the local branch, where he sells his wares at his stall, Arcane Devices.
Mennir Many-Legs is a Bosmer follower of Selene. She acts as one of the bosses in Selene's Web.
Melina is a Breton enchanter and a member of the Daggerfall Covenant in . She is selling her wares in the Enchanter's Tower at the Northern High Rock Gate, Cyrodiil.
Melodie Urquine is a Breton residing inside the large house near the bridge leading to Bangkorai.
Merarii Telvanni is a Dunmer member of House Telvanni found at Heimlyn Keep in Stonefalls.
Mendicant Sulinor is an hostile Dunmer spirit locked away inside the reliquary located underneath Heimlyn Keep.
Menus Selvilo is a Dunmer commoner and patron of the Anchor's Point Inn in Evermore.
Meling is a deceased Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact found on the Sathram Plantation. Following her death, a double was made from her corpse and is hostile to anyone coming across it.
Meram Vox was a Dunmer in and the son of Urili Vox. He and his mother were devout worshippers of Boethiah.
Melar Sadus, or The Scarlet Judge, is a Dunmer first encountered by the Vestige in Suran.
Mehran Gethanol is a Dunmer laborer residing in Balmora, Vvardenfell.
Menaldinion is an Altmer member of the Mages Guild who can be found at his clinic in the city of Suran, Vvardenfell. He is terribly allergic to cats and has a low opinion of the school of alchemy.
Mercedene the Cursed is a wispmother boss found in Old Orsinium in . She is the shade of General Mercedene.
Mengerlas is an Altmer outlaw residing in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset.
Melenlan is an Altmer who can be found on the eastern coast of Artaeum. He cannot be interacted with.

Mehdze is a Redguard residing in King's Haven Pass, Summerset. He is a famous performer in Sentinel, having performed for the court thrice. He was invited to the Illumination Academy as a honoured performer. He has a scribe Naliara.
Meewulm is an Argonian member of the Bright-Throat Tribe found near the vossa-satl player in the Bright-Throat Village. He is heavily intoxicated on Syl's mead.
Melleron is a Bosmer rotmeth brewer residing in The Stitches in Northern Elsweyr. He is married to Tarazur.
Meirvale Keep Sniper are Khajiit archers found in Meirvale Keep in Northern Elsweyr. They are employed by Khasda to defend the keep and are always hostile towards the Vestige.
Meirvale Keep Defender are Khajiit warriors found in Meirvale Keep in Northern Elsweyr. They are employed by Khasda to defend the keep and are always hostile towards the Vestige.
Menagarion is a member of the Dragonguard located in Dragonguard Sanctum, Southern Elsweyr, in .
Mehrunes' Harbinger is a Dremora who can be found in Mingo Cave. She is only present if you have purchased the Deluxe Edition of .

Meya Violet was the leader of the Merchant Captains of Dragonstar. She disappeared shortly after the outbreak of the War of Bend'r-Mahk. She was captured by bandits, under the influence of Skyrim, in the Broken Wing citadel. The Hero of Azra's Crossing later releases her. Her negotiation skills were credited with being what made Dragonstar great.
Meril Hlaano is a Dunmer noble and member of House Hlaalu. He resides at the Eight Plates inn in Balmora.
Mervs Uvayn is a Dunmer Agent in Balmora. He is also a member of House Hlaalu.
Mertisi Andavel is a Dunmer nightblade living in Tel Branora, Morrowind. He is a member of House Telvanni.
Milvonu Terandas is a Dunmer member of House Redoran residing in the stronghold of Marandus.
Methredhel is a Bosmer archer and Thieves Guild member who lives in her home in the Waterfront District of the Imperial City.

Millona Umbranox is the Countess of Anvil. Her husband, Corvus, disappeared ten years ago, prior to the Oblivion Crisis. In her spare time, she is usually found riding her White Horse around the Anvil area. When she discovered her husband was the Gray Fox, she was repulsed by his life of crime, going so far as to saying that she will not take him back.
Miles Gloriosus is an Imperial Warrior who resides in Maar Gan.
Merta is a Nord vampire who resides in Morrowind. She was once a part of the Berne's clan but turned rogue and left the clan.
Mikael is a Nord bard in Whiterun. He tries to gain a reputation for his flirtatious behavior with women, whether or not it is desired.
Mikrul Gauldurson is a Draugr located within the crypt of Folgunthur. He has one of the amulet fragments on him for the "Forbidden Legend" quest.
Michel Lylvieve is a Breton farmer who lives in Dragon Bridge with her family.

Mere-Glim, otherwise known as Wuthilul or Glim, was an Argonian who lived in Lilmoth, Black Marsh, four decades after the Oblivion Crisis, and 160 years before the return of Alduin. He is childhood friends with Annaïg Hoïnart, a Breton girl. Together they embark on a quest, to rid Tamriel of the demonic floating city of Umbriel. According to the situation he was called by different names, even thinking in different ways. When he spoke to Tamrielic-speaking people he was Mere-Glim the Argonian, which cut his thoughts into human shapes. When he spoke to his mother or siblings he was Wuthilul the Saxhleel. When he spoke with a Saxhleel from the deep forest, or even with a member of the An-Xilee
Merkyllian Ramth was an Atmoran warrior who lived during the Merethic Era. He was one of the Five Hundred Companions.
Methas Hlaalu is a deceased Dunmer Noble. His corpse can be found in a cell in the Morag Tong Guild's basement in Balmora. Both the cell door and the storage room door are locked.
Methal Seran is a Dunmer priest who works at the Temple in Ald'ruhn.

Meryaran is an Altmer Knight and bodyguard of Carecalmo who resides in the Daedric shrine Ashalmimilkala. Meryaran is a masterful knight, and fiercely loyal to his master, following him wherever he goes. When he sees the main character, he will immediately attack him. For a low level player, Meryaran will be quite a difficult opponent
Meven Uvaren is a Dunmer Rogue and slaver, and resides in the stronghold of Hlormaren. He is located on the bottom level of the stronghold's keep.
Milbereth is a Bosmer Barbarian and slaver residing in the stronghold of Hlormaren. She is located on the top level of the stronghold's keep.
Miluru Andus is a Dunmer Thief and slaver residing in the stronghold of Hlormaren. She is located on the stronghold's top level, and will be hostile towards the Nerevarine on sight.
Milie Hastien is a Breton clothier who has a clothing shop in Balmora.
Milara Vedran is a Dunmer commoner who resides in her home in Sadrith Mora.
Merthierry Laelippe is a Breton farmer who can be found at the Ald Skar Inn in Ald'ruhn.
Methulu Ienith is an Dunmer mage who can be found at the Almurbalarammi Shrine.
Merilar Rendas is the co-inventor of the magically imbued spiders that can be found all over Solstheim, with her brother, Servos Rendas. She can be found in the Nordic ruin of White Ridge Barrow.
Mibdinahaz Addunipu is a Dunmer pilgrim residing in Holamayan. He is a member of the Dissident Priests.
Meryn Othralas is a Dunmer savant and director of the play The Horror of Castle Xyr. He is found in front of the theater in the Great Bazaar in Mournhold.
Mevil Molor is a Dunmer drillmaster who resides in the Arena Fighters training area in the Vivec, Arena Canton.

Mhorus Larich was a former King of Skingrad during the fifth century of the First Era. In 1E 478 a terrible plague swept across Cyrodiil killing him and his entire family except for two of his sons, Rislav and Dorald.
Milos is an Argonian Slave for sale. He is held in a cage in the slave market in Sadrith Mora until sold.
Milynea Andrethi is a Dunmer barbarian who resides in Sargon.
Mi-Ilu Massitisun is a Dunmer Wise Woman residing outside of the Sobitbael Camp, within the Azura's Coast region of Vvardenfell.
Milaya is a Khajiit soldier and member of the Aldmeri Dominion. She is found in Eagle's Strand, at the top of a broken tower sitting at the edge.
Midrasi Baryon is a Dunmer woodworker. She sells her wares at her stall, Baryon's Bows and Staves, in the market district of Davon's Watch.

Michebert Montieu is a Breton who resides in the city of Daggerfall. He can be found west of the Daggerfall Cathedral standing next to Neomi Malyne. Both of them seem to be very smitten with each other.
Midnabi Sobdishapal is a Dunmer Mabrigash who resides in the West Gash region of Vvardenfell in a small camp. She is hostile and will attack the Nerevarine on sight.
Mim-Jeen is an Argonian Slave who resides in the Vivec, Telvanni Canton.
Midar Aravel is a Dunmer noble who resides inside the Hall of Wisdom in the Vivec, Temple Canton.
Mihayya is a Redguard found in Daggerfall, Glenumbra. She will send the Vestige off to look for Captain Kaleen who apparently saved them from the drink, floating in Iliac Bay.
Merric at-Aswala is a Redguard and a member of the Fighters Guild. Depending on which faction the Vestige joins, he can be found in either High Rock, the Summerset Isles, or Morrowind.
Michelle Eugenie is a Breton who resides in Daggerfall, Glenumbra. She can be found eating at The Rosy Lion inn.
Mevilis Varyoni is a Dunmer member of the Fighters Guild. He is found at their branch in Elden Root.
Mikarur is a Khajiiti teacher for the Crescent Moons Acolytes at the Temple of the Crescent Moon in Khenarthi's Roost.
Michi is a cat who can be found on top of a small ruin in the city of Eagle's Strand, in Khenarthi's Roost. He can also be found in Mistral.
Miiga Hlaalu is a Dunmer of House Hlaalu residing inside their estate in Mournhold.
Miil Darenim is a Dunmer smith residing in the city of Mournhold. He can be found in the Mournhold Plaza of the Gods.
Miirist Redoran is a Dunmer of House Redoran residing inside their living quarters in Mournhold.
Miliril is a Bosmer member of the Brackenleaf's Briars residing in the town of Brackenleaf.

Mervilda Ales is a Breton mystic and member of the Mages Guild residing in the city of Evermore. She is found at the local branch, selling her wares. Mervilda is married to Yngrel and the author of Yngrel's To Do List.
Midakah is a Redguard pack merchant residing at her stall, Hallin's Haversacks, in Hallin's Stand.
Milva Githalvel is a Dunmer prostitute working at The Ebony Flask in Ebonheart.
Midari Selobar is the Dunmer innkeeper and owner of The Hissing Guar in Kragenmoor.
Merlisi Theloth is a Dunmer found at the ponds of Shad Astula.
Milaggul is a Khajiit brewer of the Baandari Clan. He works at the Silver Moons Inn at their trading post in Malabal Tor.
Mevis Othrys is a Dunmer farmer residing at the Sulfur Pools. He was driven away from his home when the Daggerfall Covenant attacked.
Milk Eyes is a blind Khajiit residing inside his house in S'ren-ja.
Michel Helomaine is a Breton in residing in the town of Wind Keep, Stormhaven.
Mikfar is a Nord residing in Windhelm. He has no unique dialogue.
Mereel is an Argonian member of the Fighters Guild trapped inside Spindleclutch I, Glenumbra, in .
Midrasud is a Redguard member of the Fighters Guild residing at the hall in the town of Elden Root.

Micella Carlinus is an Imperial and one of the three members of Empress Regent Clivia Tharn's Elite Guard. She and her companions first appear friendly but later turns hostile in the main library of the White-Gold Tower.
Methas Lonavo is a Dunmer patron of The Tapped Vein in Shor's Stone.
Mim is a Khajiit member of the Mages Guild. He is trapped with his guildmates at the Cliffs of Failure. Once he is saved, he will move to the Hollow City.
Messenger Narfild Deepcrag is a Nord member of the Fighters Guild. He is found at their guildhall in the Hollow City.
Michele Lothaire is a Breton residing in the city of Orsinium.
Miharaz is a Redguard residing in the outlaws refuge beneath the city of Orsinium.
Mim-Jas is an Argonian found inside the outlaws refuge beneath Stormhold.
Mickal is a Nord member of the Ebonheart Pact and a patron of the Warrior's Rest Tavern at the Southern Morrowind Gate in Cyrodiil.
Milva Bandu is a Dunmer mercenary merchant and a member of the Ebonheart Pact. She sells her wares in the Warrior's Rest Tavern at the Southern Morrowind Gate.
Milo Pouzou is a Breton found working at the Daggerfall Docks. He has no unique dialogue.
Merion is an Altmer found in the Tower of the Vale. He was a member of the Queen Ayrenn's entourage before being captured.

Mighty Mordra is an Orsimer member of the Undaunted who resides in The Rosy Lion in Daggerfall. They can also later be found in Anchors Aweigh Inn in Evermore and in the Aetherian Archive in Craglorn.
Methulu Rurvyn is a Dunmer bard performing in Abah's Landing.
Merfa Redblade is a Nord mage of the Ebonheart Pact stationed at Fort Amol.

Merormo is an Altmer wizard residing at his tower in the town of Shattered Grove, Auridon. According to the note Dismissal Letter, Merormo was expelled from the College of Aldmeri Propriety by Telenger the Artificer, after he had apparently repeated "ill-advised" experiments, causing college authorities to act after their last warning.
Michelia Pujol is a Breton residing in Crosswych in Glenumbra.
Michou Thybault is a Breton found in the west halls of Anvil Castle in Anvil, Gold Coast. She cannot be interacted.
Milore Garil is a Dunmer found in Anvil, Gold Coast. She cannot be interacted with.

Millenith is a Bosmer residing in the Fighters Guildhall in Daggerfall, Davon's Watch, Vulkhel Guard and the guildhall within the Saint Delyn Waistworks in Vivec City or Rimmen. She may also be found in the Foundation's Rising marketplace of Vivec speaking to Danel Telleno.
Merdyndril is a Dunmer alchemist and the creator of the Llodos Plague. He masterminds the outbreaks throughout Deshaan. He is found inside his lair, The Apothecarium, in the Obsidian Gorge.
Milgangor is a Bosmer residing inside his house in the Redfur Trading Post.
Milion is a Bosmer magus and member of the Aldmeri Dominion. He is found at the Eastern Elsweyr Gate, where he sells his wares at the Armory Merchants.
Michaniel Esmery is a Breton and a former resident of Moira's Hope. He is one of the few who survived the initial bloodfiend attack on the town.
Michel Gette is a Breton refugee from Crestshade. He is found in Camp Tamrith.
Michou Reyneaux is a Breton noble found at the party taking place at the At-Tura Estate.
Midura is a Breton soul shriven slaving away in The Black Forge.
Milo Geric is a Breton who can be found in Mane and Muzzle in Kvatch. He cannot be interacted with.
Meva Nelenim is a Dunmer member of the Ordinators. She is part of the team that was sent to Gil-Var-Delle by Almalexia.
Milam is a Dunmer and a newly freed prisoner of the White Rose Prison.
Milia the Gatekeeper is a Dunmer guarding the large gate leading to the fighting pit of the Dragonstar Arena.
Milvela Seralas is a Dunmer member of the outlaw gang found inside the outlaws refuge underneath Stormhold.
Mezha-dro is a Khajiit found at their settlement in the Village of the Lost. He is a faithful servant of Meridia. He was tasked to seal tears that opened in his viscinity.
